description: Pure shared module packages/shared/src/bulk-sheet.ts (+ bulk-sheet.test.ts), re-exported from packages/shared/src/index.ts: columns, header matching (incl. old-format detection and the NIT-5 weight unit hint), cell parsers, groupSheetRows (incl. NIT-10 blank-indicator rule), tier math, Exclusive conversion, parent-SKU derivation, stableStringify and the exportRowToInput test helper. Independent of FEAT-001. Design refs: design.md §3 (whole section, authoritative for every name, message and rule), §11 'Shared' test list; design-review.md NIT 5 and NIT 10.
steps: Baseline for AC-15 BEFORE touching shared: check :3000 is not served by `next dev` (context.json), run `pnpm --filter @belzo/web build` and save the route table (the 'Route (app)... First Load JS' block) to c:\xampp\htdocs\Belzo\.agents\tasks\bulk-excel-template\build-baseline.txt. If the build fails on master for unrelated reasons, record that in findings and continue.

Create packages/shared/src/bulk-sheet.ts with exactly the API in design.md §3: types SheetKey, SheetCellKind, SheetRowInput, SheetIssue, SheetGroup, SheetImportResult, SheetExportRow, SheetCategoryOption, SheetExport; consts SHEET_NAME='Products', SHEET_COLUMNS (29 entries, header/width/kind table in §3, headers byte-for-byte FR-1), SHEET_FIELD_MAX (§3 table), GST_RATES=[0,5,12,18,28], TIER_MIN_QTY, EXAMPLE_SKU_PREFIX='EXAMPLE-', INT_MAX=2_147_483_647, PACK_OF_MAX=10_000, OLD_FORMAT_HEADERS=['categoryslug','taxratepct','imageurl','status'], OLD_FORMAT_MESSAGE (exact §3 text). Top level holds only literals and functions; the alias Map is built lazily in a module `let` on first canonicalHeader call (no module-scope side effects, AC-15).

Header functions: normHeader (BOM strip, remove `/\([^)]*(\)|$)/g`, lower-case, strip non a-z0-9), canonicalHeader (alias table in §3; no `categoryslug`), columnLabel(key), mapHeaderRow(headers) -> { index, unknown, duplicates, oldFormat, weightUnitHint } where NIT 5 adds `weightUnitHint: 'g' | 'kg' | null`, computed from the RAW text of the header that mapped to weightKg (normHeader strips the parentheses, so it can't be used): normHeader(raw) === 'weightg' or raw matches /\(\s*g\s*\)|\bgrams?\b/i -> 'g'; normHeader(raw) === 'weightkg' or raw matches /\(\s*kgs?\s*\)/i -> 'kg'; otherwise null.

Cell parsers exactly per §3 (strict regex before Number(), INT_MAX bounds, exact messages using columnLabel): parseText, parseRupeesToPaise (uses rupeesToMoney from ./money), parsePercent, parseGstRate, parseTaxType, parseIndicator, parseNonNegInt(s, column, max=INT_MAX), parseKgToGrams. All return { ok: true, value } | { ok: false, error }; blank -> { ok: true, value: null }.
stableStringify(v): JSON with recursively sorted object keys, arrays in order.

groupSheetRows(rows) two-pass algorithm per §3 steps 1-9, with NIT 10 in step 2: a blank indicator becomes 'parent' when parentSku is blank OR equals sku after trimming, otherwise 'child'. Keep failedParents cascade ('Not imported: Parent row N has errors.'), duplicate/also-a-Parent-SKU checks, case-hint warning, EXAMPLE- skip warning, 'Parent SKU on a Parent row is ignored' warning, length checks via SHEET_FIELD_MAX (title/description skipped on Child rows). SKU comparisons exact after trim.

Tier + tax + SKU helpers per §3: buildTierSlabs(mrp, sp, {tier2..tier5}) (exact warning texts), tierPercentsFromSlabs(mrp, sp, slabs), tier1Percent(mrp, sp), exclusiveToInclusive(paise, gstPct), assignParentSkus(products) (LCP, trim -_/. and spaces, <3 chars / taken / >60 chars -> `P-${slug.slice(0,40)}` trailing '-' trimmed, then `-${id.slice(0,8)}`; own variant SKUs don't count as taken), exportRowToInput(r, row).

Tests packages/shared/src/bulk-sheet.test.ts covering every bullet of design.md §11 'Shared' (canonicalHeader all 29 headers + aliases + unclosed paren, mapHeaderRow oldFormat true/false cases, parser values and messages, stableStringify, groupSheetRows cases incl. owner's 7 rows -> 2 groups (3 and 2 children), cascade, case hint, length limits, buildTierSlabs AC-4 slabs and warnings, exclusiveToInclusive, tierPercentsFromSlabs null cases, SHEET_FIELD_MAX covers every SheetKey, fast-check round-trip property, assignParentSkus cases incl. 200-char slug). Add NIT specs: mapHeaderRow(['SKU','Weight (g)']).weightUnitHint === 'g', 'Weight (kg)' -> 'kg', 'Weight' -> null; groupSheetRows with blank indicator and parentSku === sku -> treated as a Parent row (single-row group, no error).
Commit by explicit path (bulk-sheet.ts and bulk-sheet.test.ts are new; packages/shared/src/index.ts is tracked): `feat(shared): bulk-sheet module for the one-Excel product template`.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm --filter @belzo/shared test passes with the new bulk-sheet.test.ts (all §11 shared cases + the NIT 5/10 cases)
AC-4 slab values are produced exactly by buildTierSlabs for S/M, L and shoes with the specified tier-2 warnings
bulk-sheet.ts has no top-level statements other than literal const declarations, type declarations, functions and a `let` cache initialised to null
pnpm --filter @belzo/shared build, typecheck and lint pass; build-baseline.txt is written
findings: Commit 3b382e4 on master (local, not pushed): new packages/shared/src/bulk-sheet.ts + bulk-sheet.test.ts, tracked index.ts gains `export * from './bulk-sheet';`. BASELINE (AC-15): :3000 not listening; `pnpm --filter @belzo/web build` on master (before shared changes) PASSED; route table saved to .agents/tasks/bulk-excel-template/build-baseline.txt (box-drawing chars are mojibake from PowerShell 5 capture, numbers are intact): `/` 2.01 kB / First Load 116 kB, `/product/[slug]` 6.11 kB / 120 kB, shared by all 87.1 kB. VERIFICATION all PASS: shared test 9 suites / 193 tests (bulk-sheet.test.ts = 78 tests incl. fast-check round trip); shared build OK; shared lint clean; api typecheck OK; web typecheck OK. EXPORTED API (all from @belzo/shared): types SheetKey, SheetCellKind, SheetColumn {key,header,width,kind}, SheetRowInput, SheetIssue, SheetGroup, SheetImportResult, SheetExportRow, SheetCategoryOption, SheetExport, SheetPriceSlab {minQty,unitPrice}, SheetParseResult<T> = {ok:true;value:T|null}|{ok:false;error:string}, HeaderMapping, SheetTierKey ('tier2'..'tier5'), SheetTierPercents = Record<SheetTierKey, number|null>, ParentSkuSource {id,slug,sku:string|null,activeSkus,allSkus}. Consts: SHEET_NAME, SHEET_COLUMNS (readonly SheetColumn[], 29), SHEET_FIELD_MAX, GST_RATES, TIER_MIN_QTY, EXAMPLE_SKU_PREFIX, INT_MAX, PACK_OF_MAX, OLD_FORMAT_HEADERS, OLD_FORMAT_MESSAGE. Functions: stableStringify(v): string; normHeader(raw): string; canonicalHeader(raw): SheetKey|null; columnLabel(key): string; mapHeaderRow(headers: string[]): HeaderMapping = { index: Map<SheetKey,number>; unknown: string[]; duplicates: string[]; oldFormat: boolean; weightUnitHint: 'g'|'kg'|null } (unknown/duplicates hold the trimmed raw header text; blank headers ignored); parseText(s, max, column = 'Value') (third param added because the message needs the column label); parseRupeesToPaise(s, column); parsePercent(s, column); parseGstRate(s); parseTaxType(s) -> 'inclusive'|'exclusive'; parseIndicator(s) -> 'parent'|'child'; parseNonNegInt(s, column, max = INT_MAX); parseKgToGrams(s) — all parsers take `s: string | null | undefined` and `column` is the LABEL string (pass columnLabel(key)); groupSheetRows(rows): { groups: SheetGroup[]; issues: SheetIssue[] } (group rows are the original input objects, untrimmed; issue.sku is the trimmed row SKU; length errors are one per over-long cell, message `${columnLabel(key)} is longer than N characters`); buildTierSlabs(mrp, sellingPrice, tiers: SheetTierPercents): {mode:'keep'}|{mode:'replace'; slabs: SheetPriceSlab[]; warnings: string[]} (rupee amounts in warnings print as integer rupees when whole, else 2 decimals, e.g. '₹857.22', '₹849'); tierPercentsFromSlabs(mrp, sellingPrice, slabs): SheetTierPercents|null (also null for duplicate minQty; empty slabs -> all-null object); tier1Percent(mrp, sp): number|null; exclusiveToInclusive(paise, gstPct): number; assignParentSkus(products: readonly ParentSkuSource[]): Map<productId, parentSku> (includes stored skus); exportRowToInput(r: SheetExportRow, row: number): SheetRowInput. Module top level = literal consts/types/functions + `let aliasMap = null` (built on first canonicalHeader call). Nothing unexpected.
